  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",

  "task_id": "LEV-CH01-EQ-1.2-UNIFORM-TRANSPORT-PRODUCTION-20260908",

  "dependency_coverage": [
    {"id":"D001","name":"NumStability.IsLinearAdvectionSolution","interpretation":"The pointwise classical advection predicate holds at every real space-time point.","effect_on_target":"The differentiable-profile branch asserts global classical satisfaction.","source_match":"Matches (1.2) on the classical domain identified in Section 1.1.2.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D002","name":"NumStability.IsRealHyperbolicMatrix","interpretation":"There exist real eigenvalues and a real basis of eigenvectors satisfying the matrix eigenvector equations.","effect_on_target":"Asserts hyperbolicity of the one-component coefficient matrix for every real speed.","source_match":"Matches the scalar assertion on printed page 1 and the complete real eigenvector characterization on page 3.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D003","name":"NumStability.IsRectangleConservationLawSolution","interpretation":"All spatial slices and temporal flux traces are interval integrable, and mass at t minus mass at s equals the time integral of left flux minus right flux for every rectangle.","effect_on_target":"Supplies a time-integrated conservation statement for locally integrable translated profiles.","source_match":"Preserves the flux and orientation of (1.10), but replaces its displayed time derivative by a rectangle identity. The source does not precisely specify this interpretation for all locally integrable profiles.","status":"unclear"},
    {"id":"D004","name":"NumStability.IsUniformAdvection","interpretation":"For all real x,t, q(x+speed*t,t)=q(x,0). Equivalently, q(y,t)=q(y-speed*t,0).","effect_on_target":"Selects exactly translated initial profiles as candidates, without imposing regularity or the PDE.","source_match":"Algebraically matches (1.3) and unchanged-shape propagation. Every profile generates such a q.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D005","name":"NumStability.constantCoefficientScalarMatrix","interpretation":"The matrix indexed by Fin 1 in both coordinates has its sole entry equal to speed.","effect_on_target":"Represents the scalar coefficient as a one-by-one real matrix.","source_match":"Matches the m=1 specialization following (1.1).","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D006","name":"NumStability.leveque01_equation01_constantLinearSystemAt","interpretation":"An abbreviation for the constant-coefficient system predicate at x,t.","effect_on_target":"The left side of the equivalence uses D009 on the scalar embedding.","source_match":"Represents (1.1) with m=1.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D007","name":"NumStability.leveque01_equation02_scalarAdvectionAt","interpretation":"An abbreviation for the classical scalar advection predicate at x,t.","effect_on_target":"The right side of the equivalence uses D010.","source_match":"Represents (1.2) with actual partial derivative witnesses.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D008","name":"NumStability.scalarAsOneComponentSystem","interpretation":"Maps q to the vector-valued function whose unique coordinate is q(x,t).","effect_on_target":"Changes representation without changing the scalar unknown.","source_match":"Matches identifying a real scalar with its single component.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D009","name":"NumStability.IsConstantCoefficientLinearSystemSolutionAt","reuse_sha256":"3ab60273bbed2a4a41d45c2805abedae6b69aa31986471916ea10514d5cae28f","effect_on_target":"Requires actual partial derivatives and qt+A*qx=0 for the one-component embedding.","source_match":"Precisely the classical scalar specialization of (1.1).","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D010","name":"NumStability.IsLinearAdvectionSolutionAt","interpretation":"There exist derivatives qt of the time slice and qx of the space slice, with qt+speed•qx=0.","effect_on_target":"Requires classical differentiability at each asserted point; real scalar action is multiplication.","source_match":"Matches the derivative notation and positive coefficient term in (1.2); does not assign default derivatives at discontinuities.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D011","name":"NumStability.IsConstantCoefficientLinearSystemSolutionAt._proof_1","reuse_sha256":"722382a9ccce9cae96a2cd573633f4b4eda1a2c6bf8555207d1738e2c97f3792","effect_on_target":"Supplies continuous real scalar action for derivatives of the single-coordinate vector.","source_match":"Compatible with ordinary finite-dimensional real calculus; adds no hypothesis on q.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D012","name":"NumStability.IsLinearAdvectionSolutionAt._proof_1","interpretation":"Real scalar multiplication is continuous in a real normed space.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the continuity instance required for scalar derivative assertions.","source_match":"Standard real calculus structure; no extra regularity premise on q.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D013","name":"And","reuse_sha256":"a1e9d43ae07930c3e694c0aacb4e671e63d32e6695fe7fc7d5676578be94c3fb","effect_on_target":"Requires hyperbolicity, scalar equivalence, and both separately conditional solution conclusions.","source_match":"Does not allow one conclusion to substitute for another or require both regularity premises together.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D014","name":"DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField","reuse_sha256":"79578f1a12b299aaf7d11fa79fd772596f42b84d45b8453a6c7a67a66ecbd2c6","effect_on_target":"Supplies the standard real field structure for differentiation.","source_match":"Preserves ordinary real differentiation.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D015","name":"Differentiable","interpretation":"Differentiability at every point of the function's domain.","effect_on_target":"Requires the initial profile x↦q(x,0) to be differentiable everywhere before asserting the global classical PDE.","source_match":"A suitable precise classical qualification; with D004 it is also necessary for the global spatial derivative requirement. It does not cover the source's unspecified nonclassical profiles.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D016","name":"Fin","reuse_sha256":"6642d4f94d76b844ea6a7f2beda672012d6a7046dc12d5fb3e8f65d4c6ff869e","effect_on_target":"Fin 1 supplies exactly one coordinate.","source_match":"Matches m=1, with no empty-dimensional vacuity.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D017","name":"Fin.fintype","reuse_sha256":"51dd2633a8452f8b87915847e537e12c45105d62da36d6186f7c32522da2cf8d","effect_on_target":"Enumerates the unique coordinate for matrix multiplication and hyperbolicity.","source_match":"Preserves the sole scalar component.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D018","name":"HMul.hMul","interpretation":"Projects the multiplication operation of its instance.","effect_on_target":"Uses ordinary real multiplication in speed*t and speed*state.","source_match":"Matches translation and linear flux coefficients.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D019","name":"Iff","reuse_sha256":"80f100ba45be2d793d601b20424617b958ad883100a9811456ef599fd5b519c0","effect_on_target":"Asserts equivalence only between the scalar system representation and scalar PDE predicate.","source_match":"Matches scalar specialization; introduces no converse classifying all advection solutions.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D020","name":"InnerProductSpace.toNormedSpace","interpretation":"Projects the normed-space structure from the supplied inner-product space.","effect_on_target":"Provides the real normed-space structure used in differentiation and integration.","source_match":"Preserves the usual scalar field and topology.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D021","name":"IntervalIntegrable","interpretation":"Integrability on both oriented half-open intervals (a,b] and (b,a].","effect_on_target":"Universal a,b require local Lebesgue integrability of the initial profile; D003 also requires slice and flux-trace integrability.","source_match":"Makes finite mass integrals meaningful, but the source's phrase 'any function' does not explicitly select this admissibility class.","status":"unclear"},
    {"id":"D022","name":"MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume","interpretation":"Projects the distinguished measure from the measure-space instance.","effect_on_target":"Selects the real volume measure for spatial and temporal integration.","source_match":"Matches the ordinary dx and dt measures in conservation balance.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D023","name":"Nat","reuse_sha256":"6a0f21fa632b8005bd5b219c8994ea3d40737abbe2548bb9e2419d917a909748","effect_on_target":"Types the dimension literal 1.","source_match":"Matches the one-component specialization.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D024","name":"NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing","reuse_sha256":"dcf87408a31c8b6c2490c9be43895047d7deaf3bfce985b210544c1f2a3e4ff7","effect_on_target":"Carries the real norm and arithmetic into calculus instances.","source_match":"No change to real scalar semantics.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D025","name":"NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup","reuse_sha256":"694681bda5ff7fb52a7a903920d62394860187b72521945afceea79f0c485d65","effect_on_target":"Provides real additive and metric structure for differentiation.","source_match":"Preserves ordinary real calculus.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D026","name":"NormedAddCommGroup.toNormedAddGroup","interpretation":"Retains the supplied norm, additive group, and metric, forgetting the commutativity field.","effect_on_target":"Supports the extended-norm structure used for integrability.","source_match":"Does not alter scalar integration.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D027","name":"NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup","interpretation":"Retains the norm, additive commutative group, and induced pseudometric.","effect_on_target":"Supports the real normed-space and topology instances.","source_match":"No change of norm or domain.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D028","name":"NormedAddGroup.toENormedAddMonoid","interpretation":"Builds the extended-norm additive structure from the existing normed group.","effect_on_target":"Provides the norm used in the integrability condition.","source_match":"Uses ordinary absolute integrability for real functions.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D029","name":"NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing","reuse_sha256":"7bb9f66f94d46fdfbad9b82a90912aa1b2a48e375d1d8d9615493fe7950bb7a9","effect_on_target":"Preserves real operations and metric along instance projections.","source_match":"Compatible with real differentiation and multiplication.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D030","name":"NormedSpace.toModule","reuse_sha256":"c8db9d1c0a0cb1c556eb4fad5a3f04dcd88a1dec19cb106bdce05d20e02e831f","effect_on_target":"Selects the real module action underlying derivatives.","source_match":"The scalar action agrees with multiplication in (1.2).","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D031","name":"OfNat.ofNat","reuse_sha256":"6e5a744902eaa16e902722279c37b66fb40c4b55dcf395d04345baf20a112f88","effect_on_target":"Interprets dimension 1 and initial time 0 through their explicit instances.","source_match":"Preserves m=1 and the time-zero profile obtained from (1.3).","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D032","name":"PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace","reuse_sha256":"29260d4130c457e006d749da1a7a685e26cd3708968cc7dc6f8bad36ae292367","effect_on_target":"Carries the usual real metric into the topology used for derivatives.","source_match":"Preserves ordinary limiting behavior.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D033","name":"RCLike.toInnerProductSpaceReal","interpretation":"Builds a real inner-product space using the real part of the RCLike inner product and its normed-algebra action.","effect_on_target":"At Real, supplies the usual real normed-space action.","source_match":"Does not complexify the scalar unknown or velocity.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D034","name":"Real","reuse_sha256":"2aa1a1632950ca1bf8655d828f2e298dffbc9327c0000d7b140e8bbd308ecc02","effect_on_target":"Types speed, space, time, profile values, and flux values as real numbers.","source_match":"Matches the inherited real scalar setting.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D035","name":"Real.denselyNormedField","reuse_sha256":"f2bd9abd865934ec9bae1ebe31e051765679510322bd7bcea0556af25c1064bc","effect_on_target":"Provides the real analytic field instance.","source_match":"No restriction on the real speed, including zero.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D036","name":"Real.instAddCommGroup","reuse_sha256":"aceadaebc453ae9b6f097e11aaaf8d9b2ed44befeaa9ca679f67cdf2227e2f2c","effect_on_target":"Supplies real addition and subtraction for derivatives and balances.","source_match":"Matches real scalar arithmetic.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D037","name":"Real.instMul","reuse_sha256":"eeea30fab680ee0597ebf6dd77c33136f8a1dbc14ca0644bce1944ad0bc8ae80","effect_on_target":"Multiplies speed by time and state.","source_match":"Matches speed*t and f(q)=speed*q.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D038","name":"Real.instRCLike","interpretation":"Real is given its own normed field and identity real algebra; real part is identity and imaginary part is zero.","effect_on_target":"Supplies real analytic structure without adding imaginary components.","source_match":"Preserves the real scalar specialization.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D039","name":"Real.instZero","reuse_sha256":"0aaa281446d53896c9fa4d9b4d9f668ab56a85d4ca31f34242b6b6e29c0cce84","effect_on_target":"Provides initial time zero and the homogeneous PDE's zero.","source_match":"Matches (1.2) and evaluation of (1.3) at t=0.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D040","name":"Real.measureSpace","interpretation":"The standard inferred measure-space instance on Real, at the external library frontier.","effect_on_target":"Together with D022 supplies real volume for all interval integrals.","source_match":"The standard real volume interpretation matches source integration with respect to length and time.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D041","name":"Real.normedAddCommGroup","interpretation":"Combines Real.norm, real additive operations, and Real.metricSpace.","effect_on_target":"Fixes the real norm and metric for solution predicates and integrals.","source_match":"Matches ordinary real analysis.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D042","name":"Real.normedCommRing","reuse_sha256":"9d6634e36de3ea694c260d3f9eb7152c89dc603ac75ad23688118139c087e40c","effect_on_target":"Keeps real multiplication compatible with its usual norm and metric.","source_match":"No alternate arithmetic or norm is introduced.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D043","name":"Real.normedField","reuse_sha256":"522f37c0f2ef641aa7095d811ec47b1cda3b9f1322911dbd22cec8f6398ee23f","effect_on_target":"Provides the real field used by calculus and vector spaces.","source_match":"Matches the real coefficients and variables.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D044","name":"Real.pseudoMetricSpace","reuse_sha256":"6d2a1b7c7cd7a3904ee0cdabd126aa5c872e543079e496495718548a290870d7","effect_on_target":"Uses absolute-distance limits for differentiation.","source_match":"Matches classical real derivatives.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D045","name":"SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing","reuse_sha256":"434472282d5e45ab3a1601c38728b245e8d0b1110d5955ad56d0f7c356ffdc26","effect_on_target":"Preserves real analytic operations through structure conversion.","source_match":"No altered scalar model.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D046","name":"UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace","reuse_sha256":"7ceb8fede74b139eb3ac93926abd01c31cb896225902798fb7655f6587b326d0","effect_on_target":"Provides the usual real topology for derivative and integrability predicates.","source_match":"Compatible with source real analysis.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D047","name":"Zero.toOfNat0","reuse_sha256":"1fe81c499a5348d0bd78dfe9fc813803ec434dc22ee1204515af15efebaf4a23","effect_on_target":"Makes the initial-time literal the real additive zero.","source_match":"Matches the initial profile inferred at t=0.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D048","name":"instHMul","interpretation":"Uses the supplied homogeneous multiplication as heterogeneous multiplication with equal types.","effect_on_target":"Connects multiplication notation to Real.instMul.","source_match":"Preserves the source's scalar products.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D049","name":"instOfNatNat","interpretation":"Assigns natural literal n the natural number n itself.","effect_on_target":"Makes the dimension literal exactly one.","source_match":"Matches m=1.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D050","name":"AddGroup.toSubNegMonoid","interpretation":"Projects the existing addition, negation, and subtraction structure.","effect_on_target":"Retains real subtraction in the conservation balance and calculus structures.","source_match":"Preserves signs and subtraction order.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D051","name":"Algebra.id","interpretation":"The algebra of a commutative semiring over itself, with identity algebra map and multiplication as scalar action.","effect_on_target":"Ensures real scalar action is ordinary multiplication.","source_match":"Matches the coefficient action in (1.2).","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D052","name":"Algebra.toSMul","interpretation":"Projects the scalar action of the supplied algebra.","effect_on_target":"Carries the real identity-algebra action into scalar multiplication.","source_match":"Preserves multiplication by the real velocity.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D053","name":"CommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing","interpretation":"Copies addition, subtraction, negation, and multiplication while omitting unit structure.","effect_on_target":"Provides real arithmetic for matrix and scalar operations.","source_match":"No change to the source equations.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D054","name":"CommSemiring.toSemiring","interpretation":"Projects the underlying semiring with unchanged operations.","effect_on_target":"Supports real self-module and algebra instances.","source_match":"Preserves real scalar multiplication.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D055","name":"DFunLike.coe","interpretation":"Extracts the function represented by a function-like object.","effect_on_target":"Supports evaluating represented linear-algebra objects.","source_match":"No replacement or identification of distinct eigenvectors.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D056","name":"Eq","reuse_sha256":"0c793a3049e6682a08e9dcc5632447c24a719db33346cc4084923f72e2061806","effect_on_target":"Requires exact eigenvector, translation, PDE, and conservation identities.","source_match":"Matches exact equalities rather than approximate or almost-everywhere profile equality.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D057","name":"Exists","reuse_sha256":"561e2e3cbaa7d3373e39687d25c230d4259c4207137f74427b44697b49b3f6cb","effect_on_target":"Quantifies eigenvalues, an eigenbasis, and point-dependent partial derivatives.","source_match":"Preserves existence of genuine derivative and eigenvector witnesses.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D058","name":"Fintype","reuse_sha256":"c71c471e3cf1992b1c4a5023f9054e2c6f8a16068c04503efb461ffe7f6542fa","effect_on_target":"Supports finite matrix sums over the singleton index type.","source_match":"Matches the finite one-component system.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D059","name":"Function.hasSMul","interpretation":"Uses the pointwise Pi scalar action on functions.","effect_on_target":"Scales each coordinate of the single-component eigenvector and derivative vectors.","source_match":"Matches real vector scaling.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D060","name":"HAdd.hAdd","reuse_sha256":"34adf3db6cebb08fe62c976181eb54a3134bc28738af15db50df73fad719fc7b","effect_on_target":"Adds x and speed*t in D004, and the two PDE terms in D010.","source_match":"Correct plus signs; solving D004 for q(x,t) gives the source's minus sign.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D061","name":"HSMul.hSMul","interpretation":"Projects the supplied scalar multiplication operation.","effect_on_target":"Scales derivative values and eigenvectors by real coefficients.","source_match":"Matches speed*qx and the real eigenvalue action.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D062","name":"HSub.hSub","interpretation":"Projects the supplied subtraction operation.","effect_on_target":"Forms final-minus-initial mass and left-minus-right flux.","source_match":"Matches conservation orientation in (1.10).","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D063","name":"Matrix","reuse_sha256":"30eaf4a17663752618d08e927cba466a56171183f435dd05eded6d7f7f43f816","effect_on_target":"Represents the coefficient as a singleton-indexed array of real entries.","source_match":"Matches the one-by-one real coefficient matrix.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D064","name":"Matrix.mulVec","reuse_sha256":"e10b4caca6e26ebf9e229ce3b67fba0529ab394c15865a22b28dae62d7692212","effect_on_target":"The singleton dot product reduces to speed times the sole coordinate.","source_match":"Matches the scalar reduction of A*qx.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D065","name":"Module.Basis","interpretation":"The library basis structure, represented by linear coordinates; D066 evaluates its vectors through the inverse coordinate representation.","effect_on_target":"Requires a complete independent family of real eigenvectors, not merely arbitrary eigenvectors.","source_match":"Matches the complete eigenvector requirement on printed page 3 at the stated external frontier.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D066","name":"Module.Basis.instFunLike","interpretation":"Evaluates a basis at i by applying its inverse coordinate representation to the coordinate vector with 1 at i.","effect_on_target":"Selects actual basis vectors for the eigenvector equations.","source_match":"Prevents zero-vector witnesses from trivializing hyperbolicity.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D067","name":"NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing","reuse_sha256":"7fa2f8ce8674d11e0db0d7cc253c4279388a27f0081b342eea836b4866b6e974","effect_on_target":"Preserves real operations used by matrix multiplication.","source_match":"No change to A*qx or eigenvector equations.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D068","name":"NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing","reuse_sha256":"d8bf879e987927aa134e8e06d2932dbeb9aac519cd0eaabcf729a30a64b55ed3","effect_on_target":"Projects arithmetic structure for matrix operations.","source_match":"Preserves the real coefficient action.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D069","name":"NonUnitalNonAssocRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring","reuse_sha256":"5fa6b1466f37b32a1d029870ce89906f0c512f4dadaf00a5d1842a72395c1830","effect_on_target":"Supplies unchanged addition and multiplication to the dot product.","source_match":"Matches ordinary matrix-vector multiplication.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D070","name":"NormedAddCommGroup","interpretation":"The external normed additive commutative group structure, instantiated by the displayed real normed group.","effect_on_target":"Provides analytic structure for generic predicates that the target specializes to Real.","source_match":"No extra abstract codomain is quantified in the target.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D071","name":"NormedAddGroup.toAddGroup","interpretation":"Projects the existing additive group.","effect_on_target":"Supports subtraction of real integral values.","source_match":"Preserves ordinary mass differences.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D072","name":"NormedField.toNormedSpace","reuse_sha256":"6a5b357a68caa00d7dc32d712f1b8c5104523b992f71f2914e5f73b302745baa","effect_on_target":"Supplies multiplication as the field's action on itself in vector derivative instances.","source_match":"Agrees with the scalar coefficient action.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D073","name":"NormedSpace","interpretation":"The external norm-compatible module structure over a normed field.","effect_on_target":"Used with Real over Real, giving ordinary scalar calculus and integration.","source_match":"No change of scalar field or solution domain.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D074","name":"Pi.Function.module","reuse_sha256":"8a4a9898923965fc39eb265304fd5fb3d590000978e82f4b317c94be9140c488","effect_on_target":"Gives coordinatewise real linear structure to the singleton vector space.","source_match":"Matches R^1.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D075","name":"Pi.addCommMonoid","interpretation":"Builds pointwise additive commutative monoid structure from coordinate monoids.","effect_on_target":"Supports addition in the singleton vector space and its module.","source_match":"Matches componentwise vector addition.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D076","name":"Real.commRing","interpretation":"Builds the commutative ring using the displayed real addition, multiplication, zero, one, negation, and subtraction.","effect_on_target":"Fixes real arithmetic across the scalar and vector branches.","source_match":"Matches the real equations and flux.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D077","name":"Real.instAdd","reuse_sha256":"eb0653ae65a2f51b007444e665c04aad111c9d9c2fc7606b1482ca308344c7d1","effect_on_target":"Implements addition in the translation identity and PDE.","source_match":"Preserves the source's arithmetic signs.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D078","name":"Real.instAddCommMonoid","interpretation":"The standard inferred additive commutative monoid on Real.","effect_on_target":"Supports real and function-space module instances.","source_match":"No change to scalar addition or zero.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D079","name":"Real.instCommSemiring","interpretation":"The standard inferred commutative semiring on Real.","effect_on_target":"Supports the identity real algebra.","source_match":"Preserves multiplication by the velocity.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D080","name":"Real.semiring","interpretation":"The standard inferred semiring on Real.","effect_on_target":"Supports real self-action and the eigenbasis's coefficient field operations.","source_match":"Matches real linear algebra.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D081","name":"SeminormedAddCommGroup.toPseudoMetricSpace","interpretation":"Projects the supplied pseudometric.","effect_on_target":"Carries the real norm topology into generic analytic definitions.","source_match":"Preserves the classical topology.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D082","name":"Semiring.toModule","interpretation":"A semiring acts on itself by multiplication, with its distributive laws.","effect_on_target":"Identifies real scalar action with real multiplication.","source_match":"Matches speed*qx.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D083","name":"SubNegMonoid.toSub","interpretation":"Projects the existing subtraction operation.","effect_on_target":"Provides real subtraction for integral differences.","source_match":"Matches final-minus-initial and left-minus-right orientation.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D084","name":"instHAdd","reuse_sha256":"5fc0c612d0920e1834de2b7fb8362d69187f524afc53380dafb8141a620820f5","effect_on_target":"Connects addition notation to real or pointwise vector addition.","source_match":"Preserves scalar-system equivalence and PDE addition.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D085","name":"instHSMul","interpretation":"Uses the existing scalar action as heterogeneous scalar multiplication.","effect_on_target":"Connects notation to real multiplication and pointwise vector scaling.","source_match":"Matches the PDE coefficient and eigenvalue actions.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D086","name":"instHSub","interpretation":"Uses existing subtraction as heterogeneous subtraction with equal types.","effect_on_target":"Connects conservation differences to real subtraction.","source_match":"Preserves signs in (1.10).","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D087","name":"intervalIntegral","interpretation":"The integral on (a,b] minus the integral on (b,a], giving an oriented interval integral.","effect_on_target":"Makes the rectangle balance valid for arbitrary endpoint order; integrability is separately required.","source_match":"Matches oriented definite integrals. The time-integrated versus time-differentiated distinction is recorded at D003.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D088","name":"AddCommGroup.toDivisionAddCommMonoid","interpretation":"Builds the subtraction commutative monoid using the original additive group's operations.","effect_on_target":"Supports real subtraction and zero in the generic integral expressions.","source_match":"No change in conservation arithmetic.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D089","name":"AddCommMagma.toAdd","interpretation":"Projects the existing addition operation.","effect_on_target":"Preserves addition through additive instance chains.","source_match":"Matches real and componentwise sums.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D090","name":"AddCommMonoid.toAddCommSemigroup","interpretation":"Retains the additive semigroup and commutativity law.","effect_on_target":"Supports unchanged addition in vector-space instances.","source_match":"Preserves the one-component system arithmetic.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D091","name":"AddCommSemigroup.toAddCommMagma","interpretation":"Retains addition and commutativity while forgetting associativity structure.","effect_on_target":"Carries unchanged addition to notation instances.","source_match":"No alteration of PDE sums.","status":"pass"},
